description: User lands on the onboarding/welcome screen — top of the signup conversion funnel
User requests an email sign-in code on the sign-in screen
User taps Continue with Google on the sign-in screen
User successfully completes sign-in (email code verified)
User submits email/password to create an account
User taps Continue with Google on the sign-up screen
User successfully completes account creation after email verification
User signs out from the onboarding screen
User confirms their selected learning language
User taps Continue on the home screen to resume their current lesson
User taps the video call button on the home screen to start an AI conversation
